comments.content:
Kaggle does not let me send you DMs (disabled by user).

I am in Japan (GMT+9) and could help with GPT and Claude, plus maybe some generation for GLM or other models via open router.

I have a pretraining dataset created from public datasets I scraped, filter by license, and cleaned. I have been working on model trimming (removing layers, experts, etc), the trimmed variants score basically the same as the full variants but with much less GPU use at inference.

firstMessage.content:
Hi all,

We’re a small team in Name That LLM looking for one more teammate, ideally based in Europe, the US, or Australia, who can generate training passages from the overseas model families — Claude first, plus GPT and Gemini if you have access.

What we offer:

Ample compute: 96GB VRAM available for training, validation, and experiments.

A collaborative team — we discuss ideas, share improvements, and iterate together.

We cover the other model families, so your data fills the main gap.

What we need:

API access to Claude (Anthropic API, Bedrock, Vertex AI, or the Kaggle Model Proxy all work).

A moderate, reasonable-cost generation batch using prompts we provide.

Sharing the generated passages in the team workspace. No public release needed — self-generated data within reasonable cost is allowed under the rules.

If interested, reply here or DM me with your location/time zone, which APIs you can access, and any relevant Kaggle/NLP background.

Team merger deadline is January 6, 2027, so we’d like to move fairly soon. Happy to answer questions first.

Thanks and good luck to everyone.
